title: Compare beams
hints: The metal has the same work function.
Use the frequency in the kinetic-energy equation.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $KE_\mathrm{max}$ depends on photon frequency and the fixed work function.
statement:
Two beams both exceed threshold for the same metal. Beam Y has a higher frequency but lower intensity than beam X. Which statement is guaranteed?

[_]{a}

choices: Y has greater maximum photoelectron kinetic energy.
Y must eject more electrons per second.
Both have the same kinetic-energy maximum.
X has larger maximum kinetic energy because it is brighter.
explanations: It has higher energy per photon.
The count also depends on photon flux and yield.
Brightness does not set energy per photon.
